semiconductor_relevance: High — Inseto Europe specializes in wafer probing equipment and accessories, which are critical for semiconductor testing and development.
summary: Inseto Europe showcases SemiProbe’s modular Probe Station for Life (PS4L) wafer probing equipment, designed for various applications including MEMS and RF testing. They also offer dicing blades and high-quality virgin wafers, catering to the needs of semiconductor manufacturers.
